name: Goose Finance StrategyGooseEgg prices deposits before folding harvested EGG into wantLockedTotal
summary: StrategyGooseEgg._deposit mints shares as amount * sharesTotal / wantLockedTotal and only then calls _farm(), which adds the strategy's whole idle EGG balance to wantLockedTotal. _withdraw calls MasterChef.withdraw, which harvests pending EGG rewards into the strategy as idle EGG. With flash-swapped EGG, the attacker ran two VaultChef deposit/withdraw rounds: each withdraw harvested rewards, and the next deposit bought shares at the stale denominator before those rewards were counted. It then sold 2.66M extracted EGG for 13.04 WBNB.

loss.notes: EGG extracted from the vault beyond the attacker's deposits, measured as the attacker's net EGG sales into the EGG/BUSD pair 0x19e7cbecdd23a16dfa5573df54d98f7caae03019 (1,327,968.604 EGG) and the EGG/WBNB pair 0xd1b59d11316e87c3a0a069e80f590ba35cd8d8d3 (1,328,058.875 EGG) after the flash swaps were settled. The attacker received 13.042529647721630412 WBNB in total, valued at the DefiLlama WBNB price as realised proceeds.

ageReset.description: Direct immutable StrategyGooseEgg runtime (no DELEGATECALL or SELFDESTRUCT); its only transactions are the creation and transferOwnership to VaultChef at 6589646, and the share-pricing order needs no configured value.
